messages.content:
You answer a question about machines at work (law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, company and plant
documents) using ONLY the numbered passages given. Each passage is headed by its document, its place and its rank.

Rules:
- Use only the passages. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- Answer only if a passage states the answer for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the same article
  and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline). A passage about a neighbouring subject does not
  answer the question: then the kind is "unknown" and the value is null. A question about something that happened
  (the date of the last check, whether something is overdue today) is "unknown" unless a passage records that event.
- A passage marked "corrected by the corrigendum" already shows the corrected wording: reason with it. The old
  wording, given in the mark, is no longer valid.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the passages, one by one. A repeal or an
  application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a date is still fully in
  force on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does not yet bind on earlier days.
- When passages of different rank disagree, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's manual,
  then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.) wins over a
  ministerial decree (DM). Say which one wins.
- A row of a table belongs to the thing named in that same row. Read the row of the item asked about, not a
  neighbouring row. When the question itself states a condition ("if it were in regular use", "built in 2017"),
  reason with that condition.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / by which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "how often / for how
  long / within what time" is "duration"; "can / may / is / does / must" is "boolean"; "which / what (several
  things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition is "text" (one short sentence naming every element asked for).
- Point at the evidence: for every passage you rely on, copy word for word the sentence, or the table row, that
  states what you use. Copy exactly, without changing a character; do not join text from two places.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "what the passages say and how it leads to the answer, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y", "P6M", "P45D", "PT1H" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "evidence": [{"passage": <number>, "quote": "<copied exactly from that passage>"}]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: The manual of the MA STAR two post lift carries an EC declaration of conformity to Directive 2006/42/EC. For a unit of the same model placed on the market on 1 March 2027, must the CE marking be followed by the identification number of a notified body?

Passages:
[0] eu-dir-2014-68, Annex III, 5 — rank: law
5. CE marking and EU declaration of conformity 5.1. 5.2. A copy of the EU declaration of conformity shall be made available to the relevant authorities upon request. If the notified body referred to in point 3 agrees and under its responsibility, the manufacturer may also affix the notified body’s identification number to the pressure equipment. 6. If the notified body agrees and under its responsibility, the manufacturer may affix the notified body’s identification number to the pressure equipment during the manufacturing process.

[1] eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 19(3) — rank: law
Article 19 Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking and other markings. 3. The CE marking on lifts shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body involved in any of the following conformity assessment procedures: (a) the final inspection referred to in Annex V; (b) unit verification, referred to in Annex VIII; (c) quality assurance referred to in Annexes X, XI or XII.

[2] REG, Art. 24(3) — rank: law
Article 24 Rules for affixing the CE marking to machinery and related products. 3. Where the conformity of machinery or a related product is assessed in accordance with the conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25(2), points (a), (b) and (c) and in Article 25(3), points (b), (c) and (d), the CE marking shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body involved in that procedure. The identification number of that notified body shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer or the manufacturer’s authorised representative.

[3] eu-dir-2014-34, Annex V, 5 — rank: law
5. CE marking, EU declaration of conformity and attestation of conformity 5.1. 5.2. A copy of the EU declaration of conformity shall accompany every product other than a component. If the notified body referred to in point 3 agrees and under its responsibility, the manufacturer may also affix the notified body’s identification number to the products other than components. 5.3. 6. If the notified body agrees and under its responsibility, the manufacturer may affix the notified body’s identification number to the products during the manufacturing process.

[4] eu-dir-2014-68, Art. 19(4) — rank: law
Article 19 Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking. 4. The CE marking shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body, where that body is involved in the production control phase. The identification number of the notified body shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer or his authorised representative.

[5] eu-dir-2014-34, Art. 16(3) — rank: law
Article 16 Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking and other markings. 3. The CE marking shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body, where that body is involved in the production control phase. The identification number of the notified body shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer or his authorised representative.

[6] eu-reg-2016-425, Art. 17(3) — rank: law
Article 17 Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking. 3. For category III PPE, the CE marking shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body involved in the procedure set out in Annex VII or VIII. The identification number of the notified body shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer or his authorised representative.

[7] eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 19(4) — rank: law
Article 19 Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking and other markings. 4. The CE marking on safety components for lifts shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body involved in any of the following conformity assessment procedures: (a) product quality assurance referred to in Annex VI; (b) full quality assurance referred to in Annex VII; (c) conformity to type with random checking for safety components for lifts referred to in Annex IX.

[8] eu-dir-2014-33, Recital 24 — rank: law
(24) The CE marking, indicating the conformity of a lift or safety component for lifts, is the visible consequence of a whole process comprising conformity assessment in a broad sense. General principles governing the CE marking are set out in Regulation (EC) No 765/2008. Rules governing the affixing of the CE marking should be laid down in this Directive.

[9] eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 19(5) — rank: law
Article 19 Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking and other markings. 5. The identification number of the notified body shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer or his authorised representative or by the installer or his authorised representative. The CE marking and the identification number of the notified body may be followed by any other mark indicating a special risk or use.

[10] eu-reg-2016-425, Annex VIII, 5 — rank: law
5. CE marking and EU declaration of conformity 5.1. The manufacturer shall affix the CE marking and, under the responsibility of the notified body referred to in point 3.1, the latter's identification number to each individual item of PPE that is in conformity with the type described in the EU type-examination certificate and satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation. 5.2. The manufacturer shall draw up a written EU declaration of conformity for each PPE model and keep it at the disposal of the national authorities for 10 years after the PPE has been placed on the market. The EU declaration of conformity shall identify the PPE model for which it has been drawn up. A copy of the EU declaration of conformity shall be made available to the relevant authorities upon request. 6. The manufacturer shall, for 10 years after the PPE has been placed on the market, keep at the disposal of the national authorities: (a) the documentation referred to in point 3.1; (b) the information related to the change referred to in point 3.5, as approved; (c) the decisions and reports of the notified body referred to in points 3.5, 4.3 and 4.4. 7. The notified body shall inform its notifying authority of quality system approvals issued or withdrawn, and shall, periodically or upon request, make available to its notifying authority the list of such quality system approvals refused, suspended or otherwise restricted. The notified body shall inform the other notified bodies of quality system approvals which it has refused, suspended, withdrawn or otherwise restricted, and, upon request, of such quality system approvals which it has issued.

[11] eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 2(21) — rank: law
(21) ‘CE marking’ means a marking by which the installer or the manufacturer indicates that the lift or safety component for lifts are in conformity with the applicable requirements set out in Union harmonisation legislation providing for its affixing.
